name: Rensa-Nexus Button Art Studio
author: RensaBYDP

sections.description:
Rensa-Nexus Button Art Studio provides a visual button designer, reusable presets, a shortcode, and a dynamic Gutenberg block. Choose shapes, typography, colors, background and text gradients, motion, and bevel settings, then apply designs to supported page targets.

Learn more about the plugin at Nexus Rensa, or visit Rensa to explore the main site.

WordPress Core and Gutenberg targets are available by default. WooCommerce and Elementor target options appear when those plugins are active. Neither integration is required to use the core designer or shortcode.

This standalone Free plugin does not require a license key or online activation. Button Art Studio Pro is in development; planned features include cyber-style buttons, metallic backgrounds, custom background-image uploads, and expanded glow settings.

Compatibility

The plugin itself requires WordPress 6.3 or later and PHP 7.4 or later. WooCommerce and Elementor are optional integrations.

Current upstream releases checked November 24, 2026:
* WordPress 7.1.4. The Tested up to field uses the major.minor version, 7.1. The plugin’s Gutenberg block uses Block API v3, which is compatible with the always-iframed post editor in WordPress 7.1.
* WooCommerce 11.3.1 requires WordPress 7.0 or later and PHP 7.4 or later. WooCommerce targeting with this release therefore requires WordPress 7.0 or later.

The WooCommerce integration styles classic and block buttons using frontend CSS selectors; it does not call WooCommerce Store API or REST endpoints. No migration for the WooCommerce 11.3.1 API or security changes was identified. WooCommerce documents block markup and internal CSS classes as subject to change, so test the product, cart, and checkout button targets against the active theme and WooCommerce blocks after updates. These upstream versions and requirements do not replace runtime testing of the plugin integrations on those releases.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/rensa-nexus-button-art-studio directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  3. Open Rensa-Nexus Button Art Studio in the WordPress admin menu to create a preset.
  4. Use the generated [rensbuar_button preset="your-preset"] shortcode or insert the Rensa-Nexus Button Art Studio block in Gutenberg.
sections.faq:
Do I need WooCommerce?

No. The core designer, presets, shortcode, and Gutenberg block work without WooCommerce. WooCommerce-specific target choices are shown when WooCommerce is active.

Do I need Elementor?

No. Elementor-specific target choices are shown when Elementor is active; WordPress Core and Gutenberg targets remain available independently.

How are presets stored?

Presets are stored in the site’s WordPress options and remain available when the plugin is updated.

Can other plugins display promotional notices on Button Art Studio pages?

The plugin removes standard admin notices containing recognizable promotional language or links to external sites other than WordPress.org domains on its own admin pages. Error and warning notices are kept. This does not block custom UI outside standard notices or changes made directly to the plugin.
sections.changelog:
1.1.2

  • Hide recognized third-party promotional admin notices on Button Art Studio pages.
  • Refresh WordPress and WooCommerce compatibility notes.

1.0.5

  • Clarify the Gutenberg block title and description and add a custom block icon.

1.0.4

  • Use an inline SVG block icon so it displays on the WordPress.org plugin page.
  • Rewrite the block editor script in plain JavaScript so it loads without a build step.

1.0.3

  • Use Block API v3 and require WordPress 6.3 or later for iframe editor compatibility.

1.0.2

  • Validate gradient text colors and align block API metadata and script dependencies with the declared WordPress minimum.
  • Scope published preset ID retrieval to users who can edit posts and use a prefixed admin page slug.
  • Use the prefixed [rensbuar_button] shortcode; replace the pre-release [bas_button] tag in existing content.

1.0.1

  • Address plugin review findings and migrate plugin identifiers while preserving existing settings and preset content.

1.0.0

  • Initial Free release.
